title: Sr. Solutions Engineer
searchText: Sr. Solutions Engineer Databricks FEQ327R37 At Databricks, a customer-centric mindset and a culture of proactiveness guide everything we do. We build a unified platform that makes data and AI accessible to everyone, turning insights into action. You will be an essential part of this mission, using your technical and business expertise to demonstrate how our Data Intelligence Platform helps customers solve complex data challenges. You'll join a collaborative team that values innovation, creativity, and continuous improvement — building customised solutions that drive real business outcomes. Join us in our quest to change how people work with data! The impact you will have: Form successful relationships with clients throughout your assigned territory, delivering technical and business value alongside an Account Executive and a Senior Solutions Architect. Gain excitement from clients about Databricks through hands-on evaluation and programming, integrating with the wider cloud ecosystem and 3rd party applications. Contribute to building the Databricks technical community through workshops, seminars, and meet-ups. Become a trusted Big Data Analytics advisor by authoring reference architectures, how-tos, and demo applications. Take ownership of your running projects, driving them forward with basic project management discipline and a strong sense of accountability. Develop both technically and in pre-sales with the goal of becoming an independently operating Solutions Architect. What we look for: Ability to work with clients, create a compelling narrative, identify pain-points, and independently deliver technical propositions that drive tangible business value — building toward a trusted advisor skillset. A desire to deeply understand business challenges and provide value-driving technical solutions to address them. Proficiency in a core programming language such as Python, Java, or Scala. Builder mindset with a passion for quick prototyping; first experiences in vibe coding are a plus. Knowledgeable in a core Big Data Analytics domain with exposure to advanced proofs-of-concept and an understanding of a major public cloud platform. Joy in drilling deeper on tough technical questions and solution architecture while always keeping the big picture in mind. Experience in the delivery of retail industry projects is a strong plus. Spikes in production-grade SQL/DWH or ML/AI are advantageous. Fluency in German is a strong advantage. About Databricks Databricks is the data and AI company. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow. To learn more, follow Databricks on Twitter , LinkedIn and Facebook . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region, please visit https://www.mybenefitsnow.com/databricks . Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. Compliance If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.
